name: The Coca-Cola Foundation
program: Water stewardship and community water grants
collect_note: Page watch only: the Foundation does not publish calls for proposals and states it does not accept unsolicited grant proposals; its SmartSimple request portal says applicants are invited by email, so there is no public call list to collect. The foundation page (which redirects to /about-us/people-and-communities/the-coca-cola-foundation) is watched twice a day and any change to its grant wording is flagged for review, which is the only signal that an open call could appear.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET 2026-11-12: https://www.coca-colacompany.com/foundation HTTP 200 text/html after redirect to /about-us/people-and-communities/the-coca-cola-foundation (244 KB, 26.7 KB text). Page states 'Grant proposals ... we do not accept unsolicited proposals for grants'. Community Partner Portal link -> https://coca-cola.smartsimple.com/s_Login.jsp HTTP 200 (login page, 18 KB): 'The Coca-Cola Foundation no longer accepts unsolicited community funding requests. You will be notified by email if you are invited to submit a Foundation grant application.' No public opportunity list (s_PublicOpportunities.jsp and s_OpportunityList.jsp 404). Feeds /feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /wp-json/wp/v2/types, /jsonapi, /api/grants all 404. robots.txt HTTP 200 lists sitemap; sitemap has 539 URLs, no calls section. Grants.gov search2 keyword Coca-Cola: 0 hits. EU SEDIA POST: unrelated results only. Recon: endpoint_recon verdict html_ok, no opportunity endpoint; Chrome stage refused on port 9333.
